relations: Clay 与 Vero：势不两立的对头；Clay 当面放话要在泥里操他并把他留在空坟里——"You wanted me here, remember? No take-backs now. I can’t wait until it’s my turn with you. I plan to fuck you face down in the dirt and leave you in an empty grave."；他与 Vero 争夺同一名猎物 Kayla（Clay 的名字被 Kayla 写在表单上）。

Brawley 与 Vero：占有欲极强的伴侣，Vero 是他“一生中唯一的人”——"Don’t ever think anyone else in this world could make me care. He is my only one in this lifetime, and I will follow him into the next. You’re just like everyone else to me: disposable."

Brawley 与 Kayla：敌对兼性威胁；他抓她后颈并宣称要把她活埋——"You hurt him . . . emotionally, and after Clay fucks you and leaves you in an empty grave, I will bury you alive. Then I’ll sit there and listen to your screams."
Clay 与 Kayla：纯粹的敌对与肢体对抗；Kayla 打中他头部后他关掉手电消失在黑暗里（"I swing back with my free hand, catching him on the side of the head"）。
Vero 与 Kayla：从猎人与猎物转为互相试探的调情关系；Vero 称她 "my paper-cut princess"，她威胁 "I will find you, and then I will end you"，章末由她主动吻了他。

Vero 与群演/“怪物”们：发号施令的“主人”，能通过广播与隐藏扩音器调度整场追杀（"the speakers crackle"、"The room is empty except for a single bulb hanging from a chain"）；他挑选演员扮演 Jason，透露 "I picked the biggest guy we have for Jason, and his name is Gerald, by the way. Lovely man—breeds rabbits."
Jason/Gerald 与 Kayla：拦截者；他挡住唯一通道，她只能退回——"Jason takes one slow step forward, and I turn back the way I came, moving faster than I did before."
Ares 与 Kayla：同为戴手环的一对，被 Nixie 用颜色分配归属；Ares 戴黄色手环、她戴会闪蓝黑黄三色的手环——"This has to be Ares; he is the only one I haven’t come up against yet."

Nixie 与所有参与者：主持/规则制定者，宣布手环是追踪器、颜色决定归属，并警告不得进入玉米地——"The wristbands are trackers, in case you get lost, and the colors tell these beautiful monsters exactly who you belong to tonight."；"The only warning—stay out of the cornfield."
